name: code-review
description: Run a read-only code review workflow that scopes changes, identifies findings, and checks residual risk.

stages.name: review-scope
prompt: Create a concise code review scope from input.intent and input.review.
Identify the likely diff target, affected areas, user-facing behavior, and verification expectations.
Use read-only inspection commands when feasible. Do not modify files.

stages.name: inspect-changes
prompt: Read input.scopeFile, then inspect the relevant repository changes.
Prioritize bugs, regressions, correctness risks, security-sensitive behavior, and missing tests. Avoid style-only findings unless they block correctness.
Return Markdown findings ordered by severity with file references, impact, and concrete remediation.

stages.name: risk-check
prompt: Read input.findingsFile, then perform a second-pass risk check.
Look for missing tests, unverified assumptions, deployment or compatibility risks, and any false-positive findings that should be softened or removed.
Return Markdown with final recommendation, residual risk, and suggested verification commands.
